cat > /app/work/fullcheck.py <<'PYEOF'
"""Cross-check every (request, response) pair."""
import json
import sys
import importlib.util

sys.path.insert(0, "/app/work")
import checker

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("planner", "/app/submission/planner.py")
planner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(planner)


def run(reqf, resf, verbose=True):
    n_inv = n_opt = n_inf = n_bad = 0
    for i, (lr, ls) in enumerate(zip(open(reqf), open(resf))):
        lr = lr.strip("\n")
        ls = ls.strip("\n")
        if not lr and not ls:
            continue
        resp = json.loads(ls)
        if resp == {"status": "invalid"}:
            n_inv += 1
            try:
                planner.validate(planner.parse_request(lr))
            except planner.Invalid:
                continue
            except Exception:
                continue
            print("LINE %d: claimed invalid but validator accepts! req: %s"
                  % (i, lr[:200]))
            n_bad += 1
            continue
        errs = checker.check(lr, resp)
        if errs:
            n_bad += 1
            print("LINE %d FAIL: %s" % (i, "; ".join(errs)))
            print("   req:", lr[:300])
        elif resp["status"] == "optimal":
            n_opt += 1
        elif resp["status"] == "infeasible":
            n_inf += 1
        else:
            n_bad += 1
            print("LINE %d: weird status %r" % (i, resp))
    if verbose:
        print("optimal=%d infeasible=%d invalid=%d FAILURES=%d"
              % (n_opt, n_inf, n_inv, n_bad))
    return n_bad


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
